title: IngestFileEvent
description: Per-file NDJSON line emitted by `sqlite-graphrag ingest` on stdout, followed by a single IngestSummary line. Since v1.2.3 (GAP-SG-150) this is the SINGLE contract for EVERY mode: `--mode none`, `--mode claude-code` and `--mode codex` all serialise this object, so one parser reads the subcommand regardless of which backend ran. Fields a given mode does not produce are omitted from the line rather than emitted as null. BREAKING for `--mode codex`: the success status is `indexed` (was `done`), and `truncated`/`body_length` are now always present.

count.description: GAP-SG-142: emitted under --count-only, which replaces the payload. See agent-surface.schema.json#/$defs/CountOnlyEnvelope.

file.description: Filesystem path of the ingested file.

name.description: Memory name: derived from the file basename in `--mode none`, taken from the model's extracted name in the LLM modes. Empty string on events emitted before a name was resolved.

status.description: Outcome: indexed (memory written), failed (processing or persistence error), skipped (not attempted; duplicate name, invalid derivation or oversized body), preview (dry-run). `skip` is a legacy alias of `skipped` still emitted by the dry-run path of `--mode none` (src/commands/ingest/dry_run.rs); consumers MUST treat it as `skipped`.

truncated.description: True when the derived name was truncated to fit the 60-character limit. Always false in the LLM modes, which derive from the model's own short name.

body_length.description: Byte length of the persisted body; 0 on every non-indexed status.

original_name.description: Original derived name before truncation. Present only when truncated is true; never emitted by the LLM modes.

original_filename.description: Original file basename before kebab-case normalization. Emitted by `--mode none`; never emitted by the LLM modes.

error.description: Error or skip reason. Present when status is failed or skipped.

memory_id.description: Row ID of the written memory. Present when status is indexed.

action.description: Whether the file created a new memory or refreshed an existing one. Present when status is indexed in `--mode none` and `--mode claude-code`; `--mode codex` does not report it.

backend_invoked.description: v1.0.84 (ADR-0042): discriminator of the LLM backend that ran the live embedding for this file. Emitted by `--mode none`; never emitted by the LLM modes.

entities.description: Number of entities extracted from the file. Emitted by the LLM modes when status is indexed.

rels.description: Number of relationships extracted from the file. Emitted by the LLM modes when status is indexed.

cost_usd.description: LLM cost in USD for this file. Absent on an OAuth subscription, where the cost is unknown, and always absent in `--mode codex`, whose responses carry no cost figure.

elapsed_ms.description: Wall-clock time in milliseconds for this file.

index.description: Zero-based count of files already resolved before this one.

total.description: Total number of files in the batch.

input_tokens.description: GAP-SG-150: prompt tokens billed for this file. Emitted only by `--mode codex`, the one backend whose CLI reports usage per turn.

output_tokens.description: GAP-SG-150: completion tokens billed for this file. Emitted only by `--mode codex`.
